purpose: Flagship. Computes the CSDR cash penalty for a settlement fail: selects the asset-class daily rate (incl. Oct-2025 RTS increases: equities 1 bp/day, SSA bonds 0.50 bp/day, non-SSA bonds 0.50 bp/day), applies fail duration and reference price/notional, credits partial settlement, and projects forward penalty exposure over an open-fails set.
